purpose: Build the integrated Normal + RELEASED SP final-job Hero-body stat consumer and global extrema without reopening B1/B2 stat calculation semantics.

eligibility.rule: A final-job candidate is eligible only when its authoritative ConfigDataJobInfo Rank equals 4.
eligibility.normal: Join normalBondedStats.connections.jobConnectionId to normal.jobTree.connections.jobConnectionId, resolve the connection job ID, verify the materialized job.rank matches ConfigDataJobInfo.Rank, and include only Rank == 4.
eligibility.sp: For RELEASED SP only, use spBondedStats.jobId and verify ConfigDataJobInfo.Rank == 4 before inclusion.
forbidden: childConnectionIds or leaf topology as final-job eligibility

candidateSchema.jobNameCn: presentation metadata copied from the already-related job payload only; never used for eligibility or JOIN

extrema.scope: all eligible Tier4 Normal + RELEASED SP candidate rows
extrema.ties: Preserve every candidate tied at the global minimum or maximum for each stat.

required: 267 canonical Hero shards consumed with manifest integrity
all normal bonded connections directly matched to their job connection
normal materialized rank parity with authoritative JobInfo
all and only Rank4 normal candidates included
25/25 RELEASED SP candidates included and each authoritative JobInfo Rank4
all six values copied exactly from frozen bonded consumers
global min/max computed for all six stats with all ties preserved
0 mutation of Hero shards or B1/B2 frozen consumers

nonScope: per-hero extrema not required by current UI scope
